title: votecaster mega
tagline: bringing native web3 voting on web3 social. what could go wrong?
description:
We are building frames so that DAO participants and delegates can be:
  - notified on their social media as soon as a new proposal is active,
  - natively vote inside of warpcast, or any app subscribing to our openframes,
  - engage in (hopefully wholesome) discussions on the proposals.

we are of the opinion that nothing could go wrong with this. no discussions will ever turn awry! <3
how_its_made:
FRAMESJS, XMTP, THEGRAPH, DYNAMIC 

- We picked the Nouns DAO for this POC, as they currently have an active proposal.

- We are using The Graph, specifically the nouns subgraph, to query active proposal information and whether somebody is able to actually vote on the proposal (delegate information).

- We are using nextjs 

- we are using frames.js for the creation of frames and interactive components.

- we are openframes compatible !!!

- We will continue to build out this project, which will allow DAOs to deploy their own bot to create frames whenever a new proposal is out.

- We plan support for snapshot and other DAOs.
